mission: SINGLE CANARY #4 - child descent must not discharge semantically substantive parent text
failureFixed: A substantive parent/chapeau span could become COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT merely because its enumerated child clauses were covered. The parent's own independent obligations were discharged for free.

fixture.source: The Borrower shall prepay the Loans in full upon a Change of Control and shall cure any Default within thirty days after notice and shall not incur any Indebtedness other than (a) the Existing Debt (b) the Revolving Loans.
fixture.inventory: two items only - '(a) the Existing Debt' and '(b) the Revolving Loans.' The prepayment obligation, the cure obligation and the incurrence prohibition are inventoried by nothing.

before.coverageSpans: [COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT] "The Borrower shall prepay the Loans in full upon a Change of Control and shall cure any Default within thirty days after notice and shall not incur any Indebtedness other than " | [STRUCTURAL_NOISE] "(a) " | [COVERED_BY_INVENTORY] "the Existing Debt" | [PUNCTUATION_OR_DELIMITER] " " | [STRUCTURAL_NOISE] "(b) " | [COVERED_BY_INVENTORY] "the Revolving Loans" | [PUNCTUATION_OR_DELIMITER] "."

fixture.note: Three independent obligations vanished silently. This is precisely the class the trust boundary exists to catch: nothing in Pass A, Pass B or Pass C could see them again.

rootCause: Descent operated on the parent UNIT, not on the parent's RESIDUE. The eligibility test was 'do all my children have an accounted disposition?', so a single uncovered blob spanning the entire lead-in inherited a blanket exemption from the children it happened to precede. Credit flowed child -> parent without asking what the parent text itself asserted. The only guard was a whole-residue quantitative-value check, which fires only when the parent happens to carry a digit-bearing value - 'shall prepay the Loans in full upon a Change of Control' carries none.

ruleChosen.name: residue-first descent with coordination-scoped eligibility
ruleChosen.statement: Split the parent's residue at coordination boundaries. Only the FINAL fragment - the one that actually runs up to the children, with nothing but whitespace or punctuation between it and them - is eligible for discharge. Every earlier fragment is an independent conjunct of the parent's own and stays accountable. The quantitative-value guard is then applied per fragment, not per residue.
ruleChosen.independentBoundary: coordination conjunctions ('and', 'or', 'and/or') plus the ordinary span geometry already computed by the coverage pass. Both are structural, not semantic.
ruleChosen.eligibilityIsPositional: A fragment earns discharge by POSITION (it introduces the children) - never by length, never by vocabulary.
ruleChosen.conservativeDefault: A fragment that cannot be shown to introduce the children stays UNACCOUNTED_SOURCE. If the residue's last fragment does not run up to the children (anything covered or substantive intervenes), NOTHING in the parent is discharged.
ruleChosen.valuesAreHardBlockers: A fragment carrying a quantitative value of any kind is never discharged, even when it is the introducing fragment (mission section 7).
whatItIsNot: no magic threshold of any kind
no covenant-family keyword list (prepayment / debt / liens / cure / default / restricted payments appear nowhere in the implementation)
no comparison of parent characters against child characters

gaps.excerpt: The Borrower will furnish written notice to the Administrative Agent
gaps.reasoning: I26's source is 'SECTION 6.02 Notices. The Borrower will furnish written notice to the Administrative Agent within three (3) Business Days after any Responsible Officer obtains knowledge thereof of (a) the occurrence of any Default and (b) any ERISA Event ... in excess of $1,250,000.' The corpus inventories three items: the deadline and the two triggers. Nothing inventories the notice ACT itself, the modality, or the counterparty ('the Administrative Agent'). Pass B's rule for I26 carries action: null and capacityExpression: null, so the recipient exists nowhere in the compiled representation either. Before canary #4 this lead-in was discharged as COVERED_BY_CHILD_DESCENT purely because (a) and (b) were covered - the exact defect class. It is no longer eligible because a COVERED_BY_INVENTORY span (the deadline) sits between the residue and the children, so the residue does not run up to them.
gaps.note: The mission forbids repairing collateral gaps and forbids changing ground truth to get green tests. I26's expectSemanticallyComplete stays true and the two tests stay red. The correct repair is to inventory the notice obligation and its recipient, which is corpus work for a later mission.
